design.directions: D1-D7 ADOPTED 2026-11-01; exact details not yet approved
design.new_dependencies: WORK remains std-only + existing ports; HOST uses existing serde/serde_json; XML/security parsing may extend existing roxmltree=0.20.0 adapter, no new crate proposed. Existing uuid remains only trusted outer boundary. Windows-sys existing dependency may provide OS lock API; exact feature/API checked during shared adapter design.
error_model: 欄位/path/內容結構不合法，mutation前拒絕
拒未知版本，不覆寫或靜默丟欄位
視窗非該session writer，不碰內容
新建目標已存在，原檔/目錄不動
期望revision或磁碟digest不符，重新預覽
交易/寫者持有中，不並行執行破壞性操作
可存草稿，列缺決策，不生成
普通可回復IO失敗；原有效內容保持
只有新專案已建立部分產物，保留草稿並列殘留；不綁成成功
回復本身失敗或耐久不確定：保留版本與journal、停止破壞性操作，不聲稱原狀/PASS
無歷史或session已關閉，不改狀態
design.authority: UI → Tauri Command → DispatchHost → HOST usecase → WORK(domain) → Output Ports ← Adapters
design.no_global_state: Draft/session/plan maps owned inside DispatchHost; UUID candidates from trusted boundary; no static manager/service singleton
design.generation_approval: approvalRefs server-resolved evidence IDs, not UI checkbox authorization; finalizing definition does not generate or execute AI
design.responsibility: 六步定義draft、持久Project UUID、無覆寫新建、草稿續開；不生成骨架或操作文件history

storage.identity: projectUuid is persistent product identity; legacy WORK ProjectId/root registration key retained as alias, never automatically rewritten in run/lease records
storage.draft: Save Draft explicitly creates owned project folder and definition on first save. UI previews path and says no skeleton generated. Later resume is explicit open of this saved draft, not a new-project overwrite exception.
storage.legacy: Open legacy root read-only with legacy marker; first explicit adopt/save previews new definition only, preserves ESS/preferences/manifest bytes; existing projectUuid conflict blocks.
storage.copy: Explicit copy creates new projectUuid + origin reference; same UUID at two roots must be diagnosed and require explicit move/copy choice, not auto remap.

transactions: validate name/draft/native parent binding → create_directory_exclusive → write definition and optional preference copy → bind only after required write success; partial retain owned artifacts, no recursive delete
acquire project definition write lease → read digest → reject stale → encode pure draft → replace_checked → return exact saved revision
current owned draft revision + prerequisites checked; unresolved returns DraftSavedMissingDecisions; generated artifacts only M02 separate operation
invariants: 名稱/parent validated before any directory writes
Persistent UUID distinct from legacy root key; no secret or absolute path in portable definition
Definition mode draft may be incomplete; mode defined does not itself imply architecture approval or generated artifacts
No schema mutation to v1 manifest with deny_unknown_fields until separately reviewed

ipc_schema.business_validations: OS path containment, nonempty trimmed Windows name/reserved names, source parsing, UUID binding, owner, revision and approvalRefs are checked at input/usecase, not merely JSON shape. Required integer revision is encoded as decimal string.
ipc_schema.unknown_fields: Every request denies unknown fields; no arbitrary root/digest/writer/approval authority accepted.

shared_output_prerequisite.dependency_policy: reuse existing windows-sys pinned dependency; adding features/dependencies requires exact review. No database/framework.
shared_output_prerequisite.tests: cargo test -p sgenaxis-adapters --test phase1_file_commit (TARGET_NOT_CREATED; NOT RUN)
shared_output_prerequisite.release_gate: Exclusive create, cooperating OS lock, old-byte restoration at all injected failure points, lock release on process death, stale raw digest, rollback failure blocks further mutations. Not provided by write_atomic.

protected: existing tests not explicitly identified for contract migration

contract_migration.rule: Existing deletion expectation explicitly superseded by confirmed no-overwrite; new rejection test first, preserve old test as historical evidence; approved test-intent revision required, never silently weaken.
